entities.name: British East India Company
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: British East India Company, a political institution in Nepal during Gorkha Unification (1775–1816). Grew from Gorkha Empire and Prithvi Narayan Shah conquers the Kathmandu Valley, unifying Nepal. Led to the emergence of East India Company and Treaty of Sugauli.
